ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; approximately 95% of pixels are low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity pixels localized primarily to barnacle clusters and isolated spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast contiguous clusters are localized at the extreme lateral tips (distal edges). A single small, circular high-intensity spot is visible in the lower-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45-55 degrees, extending deep into the peduncle-fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Continuous sequence of peaks and valleys across both lobes with pixel amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 pixels relative to the mean edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep along the trailing edge, transitioning to a convex curve at the most lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive, dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groupings (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the far left and far right lobe extremities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle infestation on both lateral tips; one distinct circular depigmentation mark on the left mid-lobe.
